method: Opened every Dataset A product page live plus the seller policy/Trustpilot profiles, two spot feeds and the NIST/eCFR authority pages; searched each stored price, material, weight and policy phrase in the returned text. Corrected only values contradicted by the live page, preserved dated calculation anchors, and retained prior evidence in history fields.
integration_note: Additive pass on main @ 85ac1fa. Dataset A price observations did not change; source-link precision, Trustpilot drift, Aurate flag notes, Ring Concierge clarity, Catbird claim scope, CR-P15-1 and CR-P15-2 were corrected or closed. Fresh live spot observations are reference-only.
